description: Pans one signal across a pair of outputs

params.text: Sets the position between the two outputs, all the way to OUT 1 anticlockwise and all the way to OUT 2 clockwise

inputs.text: Moves the pan position, 5V sweeping the whole width, and the total is held between the two extremes

outputs.text: Carries the input at full level with the pan hard anticlockwise and silence with it hard clockwise
Carries the input at full level with the pan hard clockwise and silence with it hard anticlockwise

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
